vx_phase — VX gradient op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vx_phase(gx, gy, *, mapping) (to call the implementation directly, import vxcore; vxcore.vx_phase(gx, gy, *, mapping); from the registry, opsvx.get("vx_phase"))

Usage

Gradient phase (Section 3.41): shifts ϕ = atan2(gy, gx) into 0 ≤ ϕ < 2π and maps it to 0–255 (REQ-0364). Output U8.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

*mapping*(必須): 規格は写し方の丸めを書いていない。"floor" = ⌊ϕ·256/(2π)⌋(0 ≤ 値 ≤ 255 が自動で成り立つ)、"round" = ⌊ϕ·256/(2π) + 0.5⌋ mod 256(2π の手前は 0 に巻く)。gx = gy = 0 の画素は atan2 の約束で ϕ = 0。

Raises ValueError: S16 の 2-D でない / 形が違う / mapping が一覧に無い。
